interpretation: At 0.005 USD, a file check covers its platform cost unless it runs for minutes: break-even is about 288 s at 0.25 GB and 72 s at 1 GB.
A pure-Python structure check of a file of at most 10 MiB plus one HTTP GET is expected to take seconds, but that is a hypothesis: runtime has NOT been measured on Apify.
Main economic risk is not margin per event but volume: a run that fails (bad URL) costs compute and earns nothing; free-plan users earn nothing.
Even optimistic volume is small: 38 users x 10 files/month = 380 events = 1.52 USD developer net/month. This is a learning/first-revenue test, not a business.
